name: Base44 & n8n Presentation Generator 🖼️
description_md:
# What You Get

- A ready-to-import n8n workflow that connects directly to Gamma and auto-generates professional slide decks in under 2 minutes.

- A full-stack prompt that turns the workflow into a presentation creator app with brainstorming assistant, quick form input, and history tracking.

- Support for custom parameters (topic, audience, tone, number of slides, image style) so every presentation matches your exact needs.

- Neo-brutalist frontend design guidance plus backend + database setup notes for persistent presentation records.

If you want my exclusive versions with multiple app schemas, extra prompts, and bonus integrations, they live inside my Early AI-dopters Community — you won’t regret it 😉
